construct: padding: 10px 4px 20px 4px — four sides, top and bottom DIFFERENT
why: Four of the six padding rows were CARRIED on a code citation alone; the only measured one was padding-left, and every existing padding case is symmetric top-to-bottom, so a lowering that collapsed the block axis to a single value would have passed all of them. An unequal top and bottom is the cheapest construct that can tell paddingTop and paddingBottom apart on the canvas.

canvas.note: paddingTop 10 / paddingBottom 20 on the root auto-layout frame
